app.title: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
app.author: metrofun
app.description: Official release of Haiku OS R1/beta6, a Unix-like open‑source operating system.
proposed_tests: download the ISO and verify checksum
boot a VM with the ISO and perform a quick login
install from source and run hello_world.c
measure boot time and memory usage
run a basic network test to ensure connectivity
